name: radial-shrinkage
alt: A two-coordinate slice of the five-dimensional positive-part James–Stein rule: observations inside radius square root of 3 map to zero; outside observations move inward without reversing direction.
source: Stein risk identity and positive-part rule; Wasserman Stein notes. This is an estimator map, not a pointwise loss comparison.
provenance: Original course illustration generated from the formulas in this script; no source figure copied.

name: tweedie-mixture
alt: With prior mass one half at each of minus 2 and plus 2 and noise variance 1, the posterior mean is 2 tanh(2x). Score corrections can move observations away from zero toward either mode.
source: Tweedie identity; exact Bayes calculation for a two-point prior, no copied plot.
provenance: Original course illustration generated from the formulas in this script; no source figure copied.
